plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Healthy Me shows your sleep, heart, steps and weight next to your meals and medicines.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Healthy Me saves the water and morning weight you log here to Apple Health.

plugins.photosPermission: Healthy Me reads a photo you choose: a plate, a food label or a medicine label.
plugins.cameraPermission: Healthy Me takes a photo of a plate, a food label or a medicine label, to log a meal, check a food or add a supplement.
Healthy Me uses the camera to read a food barcode or take a photo of a plate, label or medicine.

plugins.microphonePermission: Healthy Me uses the microphone so you can say what you ate.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Healthy Me turns what you say into text to find the food.
